daily.full:
共識

今日共同看好最集中的是$MSFT，4個帳號明確看多，相關帖文12則。@TrendSpider說微軟的Azure正在加速。原帖 @TheTranscript_提到大型科技雲端積壓訂單激增至約1.8萬億美元，$MSFT財務長指商業剩餘履約義務增長73%至6770億美元。原帖 @Jason則反駁有關AI是高風險賭博的說法，強調這是有史以來最強大且有用的軟體。原帖

$AAPL有2個帳號看多。@TrendSpider直接說蘋果將目標定在400美元。原帖 @StockSavvyShay則提到$AAPL剛剛超越$NVDA，重新奪回全球最有價值公司的位置。原帖 $NFLX與$LLY各有2個帳號看多，@TrendSpider指Netflix從峰值下跌超過50%，出現看漲背離；@APompliano引述觀點認為禮來將成為全球最有價值的公司。

共同看淡

今日沒有純共同看淡的代號（bear_total為0）。不過$INTC在分歧名單中明顯偏空，1個帳號看多、6個看淡，相關帖文13則。@Mr_Derivatives說$INTC今日創下史上最大單日賣出成交量、史上最大單週賣出成交量，以及史上第二大單月賣出成交量，打破各種紀錄。原帖 @LukeGromen則質疑英特爾現在是川普的災難。原帖

分歧

$NVDA是今日被提及最多的代號之一，6多2淡，帖文22則。@StockSavvyShay引述Elon Musk稱Colossus 2年底將有約120萬個$NVDA Blackwell，其中包括20萬個專用於推理的GB300。原帖 @TrendSpider說NVIDIA目前估值為AI熱潮開始以來最便宜水平。原帖 但空方聲音仍在。@Mr_Derivatives則指$META、$GOOGL與$AMZN均低於50日與200日移動平均線，歷史上在主要均線以下買入這些優質股票通常獲得回報，除非預期更深層的2022年式熊市回撤。原帖

$AMZN同樣分裂（6多1淡），帖文24則。@TrungTPhan引述Andy Jassy稱亞馬遜未來5至10年將有兩項1萬億美元業務；@charliebilello指出AWS過去12個月收入1610億美元高於標普500指數中476家公司的收入。原帖 原帖

其他值得留意

@Beth_Kindig提到根據TrendForce，伺服器CPU出貨量預計2026年同比增長31%，2027年加速至超過40%，受推理工作負載與代理AI採用推動。原帖 整體上，AI相關名稱仍是討論核心，但個股分化大於單一敘事，沒有出現像昨日那樣集中的共同看淡。

weekly.full:
共識

過去一週共同看好最集中的是$SOFI，7個帳號看多，相關帖文26則。@Jake__Wujastyk指出月線蠟燭有相當恢復；@RedDogT3說財報後形態少見，策略以跳空缺口樞紐位做多波段；@Mr_Derivatives為$SOFI升至17.25美元喝采。原帖 原帖 原帖 $SKHY有5個帳號看多，@ThetaWarrior稱業績前掃單者今早獲利了結，總利潤約406萬美元。原帖 $GOOG與$LLY各有4個帳號看多。

共同看淡

共同看淡首位是$RDDT（11個帳號），相關帖文33則。@ripster47直說是重大失望，日活躍用戶未達預期，已在約135美元平掉多頭，形容為容易交易的100 PSYCH空頭設置。原帖 @StockSavvyShay把$RDDT列入10月成長股重挫名單（約-41%）；@KobeissiLetter指Reddit在8個交易日內下跌42%，AI已經永遠地擾亂了搜索以及更廣泛的互聯網。原帖 原帖 $BA有4個帳號看淡，有帳號指第三季錄得淨虧損並下調指引後下跌超過10%。

分歧

$SPY本週10多7淡，帖文127則；$INTC則3多14淡，明顯偏空。 $AMZN10多6淡，$NVDA10多4淡。@APompliano引述觀點認為空頭將再次被證明錯誤，華爾街兩年前預期自由現金流6億，現在是320億。原帖 $TSLA11多1淡，偏多但仍有空方聲音。

其他值得留意

$LMT與$PLTR進入共同看好前段；有帳號提及摩根大通首次覆蓋$PLTR，給予增持評級，目標價262美元。記憶體與半導體ETF買盤，與財報後網路／半導體殺跌並存，是本週主旋律。

共識

過去一個月共同看好最集中的是$SOFI（8個帳號），金融科技與財報後形態討論延續至月度框架。@Jake__Wujastyk指出月線蠟燭有相當恢復；@RedDogT3以跳空缺口樞紐位做多波段；@Mr_Derivatives為升至17.25美元喝采。原帖 $GOOG與$MA各有6個帳號看多；$NKE、$RSP、$LLY亦進入共同看好前列，反映輪動與防禦／等權主題。

$RDDT以11個帳號成為月度共同看淡首位，與近七日及今日窗對齊；@ripster47提到約135美元平多頭及日活躍用戶問題。原帖 $BA仍有4個帳號看淡。其他包括$RBLX、$HYG、$TMUS等。

分歧

$CRWV分歧最極端：5個帳號看多、24個看淡，帖文230則。@StockSavvyShay提到$CRWV如何僅用800萬美元股本，透過以合約客戶收入融資剩餘80%，轉化為4000萬美元GPU基礎設施；同時大量帳號把新雲與AI基礎設施回撤視為風險焦點。原帖 $SPY為15多13淡；$TSLA則21多3淡，偏多但仍非單向共識。

月度框架上，AI相關名稱（尤其新雲）分歧最寬，而消費金融、支付與部分防禦名稱較常出現在共同看好側。有帳號提及$MU未來18個月或見更高目標，但數字需以原帖為準。

daily.full:
Consensus

Clearest common bullish today is $MSFT, with 4 accounts long and 12 related posts. @TrendSpider said Microsoft's Azure is accelerating. post @TheTranscript_ noted large tech cloud backlog surging to about $1.8T, with $MSFT CFO citing 73% growth in remaining performance obligations to $677B. post @Jason pushed back on claims of AI as high-risk gambling, calling it the most powerful and useful software ever. post

$AAPL has 2 bullish accounts. @TrendSpider directly said Apple is targeting $400. post @StockSavvyShay noted $AAPL just surpassed $NVDA to reclaim the world's most valuable company position. post $NFLX and $LLY each have 2 bullish accounts; @TrendSpider flagged Netflix down over 50% from peak with bullish divergence, while @APompliano cited views that Eli Lilly could become the world's most valuable company.

Common Bearish

No pure common bearish tickers today (bear_total is 0). However, $INTC stands out as heavily bearish in the split list, with 1 bullish and 6 bearish accounts and 13 related posts. @Mr_Derivatives said $INTC set records for largest single-day selling volume, largest single-week selling volume, and second-largest single-month selling volume. post @LukeGromen questioned whether Intel is now Trump's disaster. post

Divergence

$NVDA is among the most-mentioned names, with 6 long and 2 short and 22 posts. @StockSavvyShay cited Elon Musk saying Colossus 2 will have about 1.2M $NVDA Blackwells by year-end, including 200K GB300s dedicated to inference. post @TrendSpider said NVIDIA is currently at its cheapest valuation since the AI boom began. post Bearish voices remain. @Mr_Derivatives noted $META, $GOOGL and $AMZN are all below their 50-day and 200-day moving averages, and historically buying quality names below major averages has paid off unless expecting a deeper 2022-style drawdown. post

$AMZN is similarly split (6 long / 1 short) with 24 posts. @TrungTPhan cited Andy Jassy saying Amazon will have two $1T businesses in the next 5-10 years; @charliebilello pointed out AWS trailing 12-month revenue of $161B exceeds that of 476 S&P 500 companies. post post

Other Notable

@Beth_Kindig noted TrendForce expects server CPU shipments to grow 31% YoY in 2026 and accelerate to over 40% in 2027, driven by inference workloads and agentic AI adoption. post Overall, AI-related names remain the core of discussion, but individual stock differentiation outweighs any single narrative, with no concentrated common bearish like the prior day.

weekly.full:
Consensus

Clearest common bullish over the past week is $SOFI, with 7 accounts long and 26 related posts. @Jake__Wujastyk noted substantial recovery in the monthly candle; @RedDogT3 said the post-earnings pattern is rare, with strategy to long the swing off the gap pivot; @Mr_Derivatives cheered $SOFI rising to $17.25. post post post $SKHY has 5 bullish accounts; @ThetaWarrior said pre-earnings sweepers took profits this morning for total profit of about $4.06M. post $GOOG and $LLY each have 4 bullish accounts.

Common Bearish

Top common bearish is $RDDT (11 accounts) with 33 related posts. @ripster47 called it a major disappointment after daily active users missed, saying longs were covered around $135 and framing an easy 100 PSYCH short setup. post @StockSavvyShay listed $RDDT among October growth-stock drawdowns (about -41%); @KobeissiLetter noted Reddit fell 42% in 8 trading days, with AI permanently disrupting search and the broader internet. post post $BA has 4 bearish accounts, with notes of a net loss and guidance cut in Q3 followed by a drop of over 10%.

Divergence

$SPY was 10 long / 7 short this week with 127 posts; $INTC was 3 long / 14 short, clearly skewed bearish. $AMZN 10 long / 6 short, $NVDA 10 long / 4 short. @APompliano cited views that shorts will again be proven wrong, with free cash flow now at $32B versus $600M expected two years ago. post $TSLA was 11 long / 1 short, skewed bullish but with some bearish voices.

Other Notable

$LMT and $PLTR entered the upper common bullish list; one account mentioned JPMorgan initiating coverage on $PLTR with an Overweight rating and $262 price target. Memory and semiconductor ETF buying coexists with post-earnings internet/semiconductor drawdowns as the week's main theme.

Consensus

Clearest common bullish over the past month is $SOFI (8 accounts), with fintech and post-earnings pattern discussion continuing into the monthly frame. @Jake__Wujastyk noted substantial recovery in the monthly candle; @RedDogT3 used the gap pivot for long swings; @Mr_Derivatives cheered the rise to $17.25. post $GOOG and $MA each have 6 bullish accounts; $NKE, $RSP, $LLY also entered the upper common bullish list, reflecting rotation and defensive/equal-weight themes.

Common Bearish

$RDDT with 11 accounts is the top monthly common bearish, aligned with the recent 7-day and daily windows; @ripster47 mentioned covering around $135 and daily active user issues. post $BA still has 4 bearish accounts. Others include $RBLX, $HYG, $TMUS.

Divergence

$CRWV has the most extreme split: 5 bullish and 24 bearish accounts, with 230 posts. @StockSavvyShay noted how $CRWV turned $8M equity into $40M GPU infrastructure by financing the remaining 80% against contracted customer revenue; meanwhile many accounts view the new cloud and AI infrastructure pullback as a risk focus. post $SPY was 15 long / 13 short; $TSLA was 21 long / 3 short, skewed bullish but not a one-way consensus.

Other Notable

In the monthly frame, AI-related names (especially new cloud) show the widest divergence, while consumer finance, payments and some defensive names more often appear on the common bullish side. Some accounts mentioned higher targets for $MU over the next 18 months, but figures should be verified against original posts.
